flags: A Nudge Security profile lists HIPAA, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR as compliance items, but Copysmith's official Trust Center and Terms of Service do not confirm these. HIPAA is explicitly denied in the Terms of Service.
The Privacy Policy was last updated February 19, 2021 (five years old as of 2026) and does not address AI training practices or customer data usage for model improvement.
GDPR compliance is stated in the footer but not detailed on the Trust Center; no audit scope, date, or specific compliance mechanisms are documented.
There is no clear documentation of whether customer data (especially from Rytr's MyVoice feature) is used to train or improve underlying AI models, and no documented opt-out mechanism.
The platform explicitly states it is not HIPAA compliant, limiting use in healthcare contexts despite claims elsewhere.
No mention of DPA or BAA availability was found, which may be required for enterprise or regulated use cases.
